purpose: GenAI-powered clean-air assistant helping families and communities navigate severe winter smog and urban air pollution.

routes.name: Sanctuary
features: Live US AQI Crown Dial with PM2.5, WHO guideline multiple, and source timestamp
Location picker (GPS or city autocomplete)
Next Clean Air Ventilation Window with Remind Me notification button
Windows Sealed, Purifier Running, and Family Safe Mode toggles that dynamically recalculate indoor PM2.5
GenAI Curated Daily Routine timeline with completion checkboxes
Direct Personal Impact panel with tappable formula breakdown modal
Quick links to Oracle, Health Profile, Inversion Alert (when active), Clean-Air Route, and Share Routine

routes.name: Oracle
features: GenAI chat returning structured Protocol Cards (title, urgency, assembly time, 3 steps, impact metrics, natural remedy, honest confidence & evidence note)
Save to Vault bookmarks and Share via native share / WhatsApp / SMS / copy
Voice dictation microphone and Room/Filter/Stove optical camera/file scanner
Answer style filter modal (short/detailed, budget cap, kid-friendly, elderly-friendly)
Dynamic suggested chips including Clean-Air Route navigation and Wind Dispersion alert subscription
Listen button for text-to-speech playback

routes.name: Impact
features: Neighbourhood Clean Air Guild with seed-data indicator and live SQLite pledge counters
Interactive Leaflet map showing local AQI stations/grid markers
Sortable Districts of Merit leaderboard
Solidarity Protocol pledge buttons (Evening Stove Curfew, Stop Open Burning, Carpool/Metro) limited to 1 pledge per type per device per day
Achievement badges unlocked by real user actions

routes.name: Vault
features: Playbook cards (DIY Box-Fan/Corsi-Rosenthal Filter, Window Inversion Sealing, Botanical Scavengers, Winter Simmer Pot with honest evidence note)
AI-enriched Playbook Detail sheet with materials, steps, cost, and safety notes
Category filters, search box, and Saved bookmarks tab
Sustainable Winter Alternatives comparator personalized to user's fuel and transport
Interactive Household Sanctuary Checklist synced with Sanctuary impact totals

routes.name: Health Profile
features: Switch between or add/edit vulnerable household dependents (e.g. Pediatric Asthma, Elderly COPD)
AI-computed safe AQI threshold vs current ambient reading
Medication dose tracker with Mark Administered button and remaining dose countdown
Clinical Early Warning Symptom Log form
GenAI Shield Directives with medical disclaimer
Emergency Rescue Protocol with direct tel: call button and WhatsApp/SMS live coordinate sharing

routes.name: Inversion Alert
features: Live thermal inversion detection from boundary-layer height and wind speed
Animated Thermal Inversion Physics layered diagram
Midday Protocol Checklist for school/family
AI-drafted editable School/Caregiver advisory message in chosen language with WhatsApp/SMS/Email/Copy dispatch and sent alerts log
Web Push alert subscription and test notification button

routes.name: Clean-Air Route
features: Origin (GPS or search) and Destination search
Walking route alternatives ranked by cumulative PM2.5 exposure (concentration × time)
Interactive Leaflet map with color-coded AQI polylines and timed waypoints
Best departure window advisor from next 3h forecast
Start Live Voice-Guided Navigation, Share Live ETA, and Save Route

routes.name: Tutorial Library
features: Start / Resume / Replay 24-step Guided Tour with auto-play and voice narration
Topic lessons with Listen button and interactive Practice mode
Ask-the-Tutorial AI box answered using app-manifest.json

routes.name: Settings & Setup Check
features: Backend API key status check (GEMINI_API_KEY, WAQI_TOKEN, ORS_API_KEY, VAPID) with direct links
Accessibility controls (font size A-/A+, Voice-Only Mode, Always Read Answers Aloud, Speech Speed)
Export / Import Profile JSON and Delete All My Data
